ov: الشتا اللى فات فيلم درامي مصري إنتاج عام 2013، بطولة الفنان عمرو واكد.
plotEn: Winter of Discontent (Arabic: الشتا إللى فات; translit. El sheita elli fat) is a 2012 Egyptian drama film directed by Ibrahim El Batout. The film was selected as the Egyptian entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 86th Academy Awards, but it was not nominated.
